added.summary: Two pinned Lucide vectors join the last-resort icon set: tree (Lucide tree-pine) and wheat, so wood and farms have their own icon instead of borrowing leaf, whose outline reads as a speech bubble at chip size. IdleResources, IdleOffline and IdleGenerators fixtures use them.

fixed.summary: A chapter's header (its name, stars and star meter) holds to the top of the path while its levels scroll under it, so a path that opens scrolled to the level to play no longer shows the header half cut.
